# `box.black`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/box.black.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`box.black` (`PlaceBlackBox`, doc 06 §2.7, §3.1): places a black box, a function of kind `black_box`
drawn with the black-box symbol and its page geometry.

- The page and the symbol copy must exist (the built-in black-box symbol `ew.gen.blackbox` draws the
  outline, CPs and inner graphics of `box`). The representation is `{functions: [f], page, symbol, pos,
  orient, rep_type, box}`; `rep_type` defaults to the symbol's and must be one the page type allows (as
  `device.place`); `pos` must be on the page's connection grid.
- `box` (`BoxSpec`, doc 03 §6): the outline, the device CPs with their function CP index, position
  relative to the representation and direction, and the inner graphics. Absent: the function is drawn
  by the symbol alone (a black-box function shown without its outline, as the CPX blocks of folios
  203 … 206). Rejected: an outline of fewer than three points; two box CPs with the same index; a box CP
  off the page's connection grid (with `orient` r0, the check is on `pos + cp.pos`).
- `target` as in `device.place`, with the function's kind `black_box`: `new_device` creates a device
  `{tag: {letter, counter: none}, kind}` and its main black-box function; `join_device` a black-box
  function of the device with the given role (default auxiliary; a second main function is rejected by
  EW-INV-002); `existing_function` another representation of an existing function, which must be of kind
  `black_box` (else rejected with a hint to use `device.place`); `from_part` the device and every template
  function of the part as in `device.place`, the representation drawing entry `template`, which must be a
  black box; `new_terminal` is invalid here.
- The black box's CPs are derived, not stored on the function: the part's CP pattern (the
  template-origin rule of doc 03 §7) or the box CPs.

Containment (a function placed inside the outline joins the box's device, doc 06 §2.7) is a gesture of
the place tool and is not done here. Outcome: the representation.

### CmdOrient2

Orientation: rotation clockwise on the sheet, optionally mirrored (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: one of `"r0"`, `"r90"`, `"r180"`, `"r270"`, `"m0"`, `"m90"`, `"m180"`, `"m270"`

### CmdPt2

A point or a displacement [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
